name: Shenzhou 5
first: China's first crewed spaceflight, flown by Yang Liwei
description: Shenzhou 5 was China's first crewed spaceflight. Yang Liwei, a 38-year-old lieutenant colonel and former fighter pilot, launched alone on a Long March 2F from Jiuquan on 2003-10-15 at 09:00 China Standard Time. He circled the Earth 14 times, in a 343 km circular orbit from the fifth orbit on, and landed in Inner Mongolia on 2003-10-16 (China Standard Time), after 21 hours and 23 minutes of flight.

events.label: LIFTOFF
events.note: Long March 2F from Jiuquan at 09:00 China Standard Time, 2003-10-15.

events.label: LANDING
events.note: Lands in Inner Mongolia on 2003-10-16 (China Standard Time) after 14 orbits and 21 h 23 min.
